iOSNotificationInfoDescription: To receive notifications on iOS, you need to add this app to your home screen: tap Share → Add to Home Screen. Notifications only work in the home screen app, not in Safari.
addToHomeScreenDescription: In order for notifications to work, the site should be added to home screen.
iOSNotificationRequirement: This allows you to receive notifications about new messages and meetings.
tapShareButton: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari
pwaRequiredDescription: CallMiracle requires installation to your home screen or desktop to work properly. This enables notifications and provides the best experience.
androidStep1: Tap the menu button (⋮) in the browser
androidStep2: Select 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app'
desktopStep1: Look for the install icon in the address bar or browser menu
desktopStep2: Click 'Install' to add CallMiracle to your desktop
pwaRefreshNote: After installation, open CallMiracle from your home screen or desktop.
notificationPermissionDeniedDescription: Notifications are currently disabled for CallMiracle. To receive alerts about messages and calls, please enable notifications in your device settings.
iosNotificationStep1: Go to your iPhone Settings app
iosNotificationStep5: Return to CallMiracle and reload the app
androidNotificationStep2: Go to Apps or Application Manager
androidNotificationStep5: Return to CallMiracle and reload the app
notificationRefreshNote: After enabling notifications, please reload the app to start receiving alerts.
notificationPermissionRequiredDescriptio: CallMiracle needs permission to send you notifications about messages and calls. When you tap Next, your browser will ask for permission.
clickAllowInDialog: Please click "Allow" or "Accept" to enable notifications
notificationPermissionNote: Notifications are essential for receiving messages and call alerts while the app is in the background.
reinstallAppSuggestion: The easiest way to fix this is to reinstall the app. This will reset notification permissions and allow you to accept them again.
reinstallStep1: Remove the app from your home screen (long press and delete)
reinstallStep2: Open your browser and visit the CallMiracle website again
reinstallStep3: Install the app again and accept notifications when prompted
goToSettingsAlternative: You can also go to your device Settings → Apps → CallMiracle → Notifications and enable them manually. The app will automatically reload when you return.
notificationDeniedNote: Without notifications, you won't receive alerts about new messages and calls.
